QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize()` logs an error and returns `{}`. The same empty vector is returned when `vocab_` is null." and "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize()` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) passes that through, and also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper passes through `{}` on a failed tokenization and also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It adds that callers can't tell the two apart.
